events.title: Infinite Loop is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hi everyone, I'm the developer of Infinite Loop.Infinite Loop is part of this Steam Next Fest (Oct 19 – 26). The free demo is available now — you can play the first map from start to finish, and the levels, skills, and talents you earn in the demo will carry over to the full game, exactly as they are.About the full releaseThe full game launches within 1–2 weeks after Next Fest ends. events.title: Infinite Loop Demo Update — Oct 18, 2026
events.summary: Improved📖 All map names and descriptions have been rewritten with richer worldbuilding (CN/EN/JP synchronized)🖥️ Various UI text refinementsFixed🛠 Fixed the "skill bar full" message displaying an internal code name instead of the skill nameThanks for playing — join our community and share your feedback!

events.title: Demo Update 10.9
events.summary: NewBrand-new "Portrait" system: from the title screen, upload your own images to create a custom character portrait — with frame-by-frame animation for Idle / Move / Death, and save multiple portraits to switch, preview, or delete anytimeFixedFixed a case where a skill's level could display incorrectly

events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: NewAuto Move is now available: toggle it straight from the battle UI, and the button shows whether it's currently On or OffYou now start with 2 skills instead of 1 — new skill: Cache GrenadeFixedMonsters from other maps no longer spawn after switching mapsFixed cases where monsters stopped spawning mid-battle, leaving you unable to continue
